Name: Nosferatu
Components: V, S, M (a damp cloth from a cleric’s robe)
Description: This vampiric art steals away the very lifeforce from a target and takes it for itself. You point to a creature within range and perform a ranged spell attack against them. On a hit, they take 2d8 necrotic damage and you are healed by the damage the target has taken.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you deal an additional 1d8 damage for each slot level above 1st.
